'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Precise Hit Profit
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
